voice_notes: Warly is warm, polite and gently humorous. He reads the world through the kitchen (pantries, pots, recipes, 'sous chefs') and drops in a few stock French words: Ah zut, Ah non, Mon dieu, oui, mon ami, Magnifique. He already calls friendly shadows 'shadowy sous chefs' (ANNOUNCE_VAULT_SHADOW_ASSIST) and an empty pot is 'Empty pot, empty heart', so the minions became sous chefs and the empty Codex an empty pantry. PT-BR keeps the French words as they are ('Ah, zut, um armário vazio.', 'Eficiente, oui?', 'sous-chefs sombrios') in relaxed spoken Portuguese ('tá', 'pra'). RU also keeps the French in Latin script inside the Russian ('Ох, zut! В этом шкафчике пусто.', 'А, non', 'mon ami', 'Magnifique!') and writes 'су-шеф' in Cyrillic. ZH drops the French altogether: zut becomes 啊这/啧, non becomes 不/噢不, oui becomes 对吧/是吗, mon ami becomes 我的朋友, Magnifique becomes 好棒/棒极了, and sous chef becomes 帮厨 ('啊这，空空的柜子。', '看看，我有暗影帮厨了！').

line_notes.codex: Warly approaches the Codex as a chef would: it is a cookbook, and the summons are the extra kitchen hands he once called 'shadowy sous chefs', closed with his habitual 'oui?'.
line_notes.codex_needsfuel: It echoes his own 'Ah zut, an empty cupboard.' and states plainly that the book needs nightmare fuel.
line_notes.no_max_sanity: A pot boiling over is the cook's picture of overload, and 'one more' tells the player that summoning another shadow is what fails.
line_notes.shadow_mine: Warm delight at a helper who wears his face, then a beat of unease ('...I think') that fits a shadowy double.
line_notes.shadow_other: He speaks politely to a stranger's shadow the way he speaks to creatures ('mon ami') and asks which kitchen it works in, since it obviously isn't his.
